statements.text: When Microsoft trades at its all-time high inside a sideways phase on falling volume, the price rose in 90 % of 10 independent cases within 21 trading days.
When Microsoft trades at its all-time high on falling volume, the price rose in 83 % of 12 independent cases within 8 trading days.
When Microsoft trades at its all-time high inside a sideways phase on steady volume, the price rose in 75 % of 8 independent cases within 2 trading days.
After a fall of 20 % from its all-time high, Microsoft came back every time: in all 3 cases since 2016 the old high was reached again within 14 months at most.
